description: REQUIRES prior comwel__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Fetch COMWEL individual billed-premium detail for a selected worker.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

worker_record_no.description: Worker record number returned by worker_select

worker_resident_no.description: Worker resident number returned by worker_select
